name: Gleissendes Licht
description: Dazzling, stinging metallic melody voice: upper harmonics dominate a quiet pitch anchor, with a bright attack and rippling FM spectrum. Velocity shapes both level and bite. Polyphonic; each note has a fresh attack. Start in C3-C6 (MIDI 48-84). Brilliance controls harmonic density, Motion controls the shimmer, and Release sets the tail. Stereo Output routes through the mixer to Master.
